purpose: Reproduce report-generation repetition with inconsistent development mock examination type

conditions.changed_input: Only the examination title in the same prepared prompt
conditions.transport: Private vLLM chat completions from the inference container; native httpx SSE line reader

interpretation: The mismatched title reproduced a native model-output loop. The matching title returned complete JSON in this run.
limitations: One run per title; these results are not a general performance or medical-quality benchmark.
The original failed request payload was already removed after termination, so this is a controlled reproduction, not an exact replay.
This experiment preceded the main-backend repetition guard and does not measure its cancellation latency.
